description: Dependency bump → build → test → human-shaped review card. Run: nklein workflow run dependency-bump --input "<package>@<version>"

card.title: Review dependency bump {input}
card.prompt:
The dependency bump {input} just built and tested green. Review the changelog/lockfile diff for breaking-change risk our tests would not catch (API deprecations, behavior flags, transitive pins) and write a short risk note in the task summary. Evidence from the test run:
{steps.test.outputTail}
